Stage : 26 - Hyperborean
Props: 26 - Empty

notes.title: v1.14 Content Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28422596/4648d10be0ae53df26a47475f9bea761b09c0b68.jpg[/img]

This update contains various graphical enhancements and fixes.
The only gameplay related change is that now you'll only receive ectoplasm after a kill, if you're locked to your target; this change is part of the new TARGET-LOCK related additions , to make sure new players notice the LOCK's importance early on.

notes.title: v1.13 Content Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28422596/4e7c96a252d77efb8db156a2e250a8e65a69dcb0.jpg[/img]

Actually there were more smaller updates, since the previous one,
with lots of small (mostly graphics related) changes/tweaks.
Also fixed a bug where the sword fails to break an item box.

I started working on the game's (IMHO)biggest issue: 
when you start the game for the first time, it isn't  trivial that gameplay-wise it is critical to use the target-lock; so there  will be more messages in-game about the importance of the target-lock, and also there will be some kind of scoring (this feature is in the prototyping phase currently) which will reward the successful use of the target-lock.

Hopefully, it will be ready soon.
